entities.summary: Katabon Mosque in Shahbag, Dhaka is a center for Muslim missionaries in Bangladesh. It houses the Bangladesh Masjid Mission and is officially named as the "Bangladesh Masjid Mission Complex Central Mosque". It is adjacent to where the stables of the Dhaka Nawab Family used to be. Katabon Mosque is a mosque. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
